title: Draft Persona A/B toggle standard (or-free)
prompt: Write a standard operating procedure file named persona-ab-procedure.md for A/B-testing voice-assistant persona builds. Context: an assistant persona runs as a backend instance; callers are routed to backends via a LINE_NAME_BACKENDS pointer map. Required procedure content: (1) clone the instance to a new port (e.g. ada-kk-b :8009) with variant env/prompt/model; (2) toggle callers via the LINE_NAME_BACKENDS pointer flip — instant, reversible; (3) measure via scenario-benchmark scores per variant; (4) adoption = flip back or retire the loser. Optional section: per-caller split routing for concurrent A/B (e.g. kk->A, nhong->B). Note that memory transfer between variants is selective bank export/import and tooling is TBD. Format: markdown with numbered steps, rollback note, and verification checklist. Do not commit, push, or open a PR. Verify the file exists and report the changed path.
